provenance.canonical-vs-supplementary: CANONICAL source is registry/new-york-v4/ui/sonner.tsx, a thin wrapper around the external, UNVENDORED `sonner` npm package (package.json:95 `"sonner": "^2.0.0"`; no node_modules/sonner anywhere under 3-source/ui, confirmed by find). Values marked [S] below come DIRECTLY from that wrapper file (the theming CSS custom properties it sets, and the toast()/Toaster prop shapes visible in its own examples). Values marked [S-supplementary] come from the SAME monorepo's real, fully-inspectable sibling 'base' style Toast (registry/bases/base/ui/toast.tsx, built on @base-ui/react/toast — also external at the gesture/timer-implementation level, but the WRAPPER's own CSS classes and data-attributes are real committed source) — used the identical way alert.shadcn.json's own structure.actions cited registry/bases/radix/ui/alert.tsx as supplementary, cross-checked (not canonical) evidence for a part the canonical file itself doesn't show directly. Values marked [R] are neither: general, publicly-documented conventions of the external sonner package, not independently confirmable in this clone.
provenance.item-bg / item-fg: sonner.tsx (canonical): style={{ "--normal-bg": "var(--popover)", "--normal-text": "var(--popover-foreground)" }} -> globals.css --popover/--popover-foreground (a DEDICATED popover role, distinct from --card, the same role select.shadcn.json's own popup-bg/popup-fg cite). [S], directly from the canonical wrapper.
provenance.item-border: sonner.tsx (canonical): style={{ "--normal-border": "var(--border)" }} -> globals.css --border. [S], directly from the canonical wrapper.
provenance.item-shape: sonner.tsx (canonical): style={{ "--border-radius": "var(--radius)" }} -> globals.css --radius = 0.625rem = 10px. [S], directly from the canonical wrapper.
provenance.description-fg: [S-supplementary] base style's ToastDescription: text-muted-foreground -> globals.css --muted-foreground. Canonical sonner's own description styling is [R] (external); this is the closest real, sourced analogue, and matches --muted-foreground's own value already resolved in alert.shadcn.json.
provenance.item-elevation: [S-supplementary] base style's Toast: shadow-lg -> Tailwind's documented default two-layer value, the same literal dialog.shadcn.json's own shadow-lg already cites (Tailwind not vendored in this clone). Canonical sonner's own elevation is [R].
provenance.item-padding / item-gap: [S-supplementary] base style's ToastContent: p-4 gap-3 = 16px / 12px. Canonical sonner's own spacing is [R].
provenance.item-font: [S-supplementary] base style's ToastContent/ToastTitle: text-sm = 0.875rem/1.25rem. Canonical sonner's own type is [R]; shadcn has no type-scale foundation file regardless (foundations/typography.md).
provenance.icon-size: [S] canonical sonner.tsx's OWN icons prop: every per-type icon element carries className="size-4" = 16px, directly in the canonical wrapper — a rare case where the canonical file itself gives a real style value.
provenance.group-width: [S-supplementary] base style's ToastViewport: max-w-sm = 24rem = 384px. Canonical sonner's own viewport width is [R].
provenance.group-gap: [S-supplementary] base style's Toast: the --gap: 0.75rem custom property its own stacking transform math consumes = 12px. Canonical sonner's own gap is [R]; this chassis applies this value to ALL columns that leave style.group.gap off (see toast.template.json's own note on this row).
provenance.group-zindex: [S-supplementary] base style's ToastViewport: z-50 = z-index:50 (Tailwind numeric scale). Canonical sonner's own z-index is [R], publicly documented as a very large literal — not cited as a specific number here since it is not independently confirmable.

structure.icon.source: sonner.tsx (canonical): icons={{ success: <CircleCheckIcon/>, info: <InfoIcon/>, warning: <TriangleAlertIcon/>, error: <OctagonXIcon/>, loading: <Loader2Icon className="animate-spin"/> }} — real, sourced, directly in the canonical wrapper

structure.description.source: sonner-demo.tsx: toast("Event has been created", { description: "Sunday, December 03, 2023 at 9:00 AM", ... }) — real, sourced call shape

structure.action.source: sonner-demo.tsx: toast(message, { action: { label: "Undo", onClick: () => console.log("Undo") } }) — real, sourced call shape

structure.close.note: canonical sonner.tsx does not itself show a close-button element (it forwards {...props} into the external package) — [R] boundary. SUPPLEMENTARY evidence: base style's real ToastClose (data-slot="toast-close", aria-label="Close toast", render={<Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm"/>}) confirms the pattern is a real shadcn-family convention, the same class of citation alert.shadcn.json made for structure.actions via bases/radix.

behavior.role.note: [R] — canonical sonner is external; role not visible in the wrapper file. Treated as role="status" per the general APG live-region/toast convention, the same boundary alert.shadcn.json's own M3 role cell used (there for a different reason — no live component at all).

prop.type.source: sonner-types.tsx: toast(...), toast.success(...), toast.info(...), toast.warning(...), toast.error(...), toast.promise(...) (loading state) — six real, sourced call variants

prop.position.source: sonner-position.tsx: six real toast(message, { position }) calls, one per value — sonner-position.tsx itself does not indicate which is the DEFAULT (all six are shown as equal buttons); bottom-right is listed first per this chassis's own default (see style.group.position), matching the commonly-documented external sonner default, [R] since the wrapper file itself does not set a default position prop

style.item.border-color.note: FIXED regardless of type — no per-type border-color override anywhere in the canonical wrapper's own theming variables, a real non-variation (see style.item.type@error)

style.item.border-width.note: [S-supplementary] base style's own `border` class -> Tailwind's undeclared default border-width

style.item.margin.note: inter-toast spacing is owned by the GROUP's own gap in this family, not the item's margin — see style.group.gap

style.item.min-height.note: content-driven, no min-height concept in any shadcn toast source checked (canonical or supplementary), a real gap

style.item.width.note: the fixed width lives on the viewport/group, not the item — see style.group.width

style.icon.color.note: [R] — canonical sonner's icons inherit currentColor by convention (external, not independently verified); modelled as the same indirection as style.item.color, the same convergence alert.shadcn.json's own icon colour row recorded

style.icon.size.note: [S] see provenance.icon-size — a rare case where the canonical wrapper itself gives a real value

style.group.position.note: [S-supplementary] base style's ToastViewport: fixed inset-x-4 bottom-4 ... sm:right-4 sm:left-auto. Canonical sonner's own default is [R] but publicly documented as bottom-right too.

style.item.type@error.note: canonical sonner's default (non-richColors) theming keeps --normal-bg/--normal-border FIXED regardless of type — only the ICON glyph itself changes per type (structure.icon), the container does not. A real non-variation, the same shape alert.shadcn.json's own destructive-only-recolors-text finding recorded.
